title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
**E\-COMMERCE EXECUTIVE —** 
 WOMEN'S APPAREL BRAND (2 POSITIONS)ROBINBOSKY \|
 **Tiruppur \| ₹15,000 – 25,000/month \+ annual bonus \& hike** 




 Fast\-growing women's \& kids' apparel brand selling on Amazon, Flipkart,Myntra, Firstcry , Meesho and our own website, with our own manufacturing unit.
 



 THE ROLE:\- Manage daily marketplace operations: listings, inventory, pricing,promotions, order flow etc\- Track sales, returns and account health; prepare daily/weekly reports\- Coordinate a small back\-office team and follow up tasks to completion\- Work daily with AI tools (Chatgpt/Gemini / Claude) for reports, listing contentand problem\-solving \- Handle our website (Shopify) catalog and order operations
 



 WE NEED:\- Good written English (reading \+ writing) — must\- 1–3 years in e\-commerce preferred;exceptional freshers with strong English considered\- Comfortable with Excel / Google Sheets; fast learner of new softwares\- Takes ownership; solves problems without daily supervision
 



 GROWTH: Written 6\-month reviews; stronger performer becomes Team Lead within 3–6 months with salary jump. Day shift, Sunday holiday.
 



 Shortlisted candidates complete a short trial task before the final interview.
 



**APPLY: WhatsApp \[900\-33\-08872]**

title: Client Servicing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 BCC Martech is a fully integrated brand management agency that specializes in end\-to\-end planning, designing, and execution of brand communication. The agency delivers consistent brand messaging across print, TV, outdoor, digital, and techno\-creative media. BCC Martech combines strategic thinking with creative solutions to help clients strengthen their brand presence. Team members collaborate across disciplines to support diverse campaigns and long\-term brand initiatives.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Client Servicing Executive role based in Poonamallee. The Client Servicing Executive will manage day\-to\-day client interactions, understand client requirements, and coordinate with internal creative, marketing, and production teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of campaigns. Responsibilities include preparing and delivering presentations, tracking project progress, resolving client queries, and maintaining detailed documentation of deliverables and feedback. The role also involves supporting account growth by identifying opportunities for additional services, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, and contributing to the smooth execution of brand communication across multiple media channels.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Client Services and Client Relations skills to manage expectations and build long\-term partnerships.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Service capabilities to respond promptly, handle concerns, and ensure a positive client experience.
* Candidates should possess effective Account Management skills to oversee projects, manage timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess confident Presentations skills to prepare and present proposals, reports, and campaign updates.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in advertising, marketing, or brand management agencies.
* Candidates should have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
